name: @pipeworx/mcp-data-gov-sg

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search the data.gov.sg dataset catalog by keyword (e.g. "rainfall", "hawker centres", "resale flat prices") — real text search via data.gov.sg's own site search, since the official v2 catalog API has none. Returns matching COLLECTIONS (topics that may bundle several datasets, e.g. one per year) with each dataset's real dataset_id for get_dataset / query_dataset. Omit `query` to browse the raw catalog unfiltered instead, paged 10/page (~4,600 datasets total).

query.description: Keyword search, e.g. "rainfall", "COE prices", "population". Omit to browse unfiltered.

page.description: 1-based page (10 results per page either way)

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Fetch rows from a dataset. Supports limit, offset, and filter map (column → value).

tools.name: weather_now
tools.description: Current temperature, humidity, wind, rain across Singapore weather stations.

tools.name: air_quality_psi
tools.description: Current Pollutant Standards Index (PSI) by region (north, south, east, west, central).

tools.name: air_quality_pm25
tools.description: Current PM2.5 µg/m³ readings by region.

tools.name: traffic_incidents
tools.description: Current incidents on expressways and major roads.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data-gov-sg forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data-gov-sg pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
